alignments.note: אַנְשֵׁי takes only its own English word. The ASV writes a single *The* for the phrase and an article morpheme stands on the chain's second nomen rectum, so the construct does not take a supplied *the* here (rule 29).
*of* on the nomen rectum (rule 19); the compound name is two source tokens and two target tokens.
Second token of the compound name.

הָעָי's article: the rectum is rendered anarthrously (*Ai*), so the article takes the single *The* the ASV fronts to the phrase's left edge (rule 29), exactly as הָרָמָה's does in v.30. Rule 29's final clause applies only where the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase at all, and here it writes one. The competing reading — supply the *The* on אַנְשֵׁי and mark this article `unrepresented` — is the one v.30 corrected, and it is corrected here.
The coordinated place name, rendered bare.
The figure's single waw takes the ASV's single *and*, which stands between the same two numerals (rule 42).

review_notes: Corrected under rule 29 and for consistency with v.30: the chain's rectum הָעָי carries an article morpheme, so that morpheme takes the fronted *The* and אַנְשֵׁי takes only *men*.

The superseded reading applied rule 29's final clause on the ground that the ASV writes no *the* for the place name; the clause turns on no *the* for the phrase, as v.30's own review note records. The chapter's six other single-*the* chains with a present article — v.6 הַגּוֹלָה, v.30 הָרָמָה, v.65 הַקֳּדָשִׁים, v.66 הַקָּהָל, v.70 and v.71 הָאָבוֹת — all read this way.
BSB independently represents this article (WLC.NEH.7.32.005 in the validation report). That is secondary evidence and not the ground of the change (rule 38).
All other units are unaffected and are reproduced unchanged.
